name: readiness_user

steps.text: Stackly checks that this instance is ready by sending PING as the user stackly-readiness, which may run PING and nothing else. That sign in fails now.
Restart the instance. Stackly writes this user again before every start.

title: The readiness user stackly-readiness is missing or changed

name: aof_damaged

steps.text: Valkey stops when the append only file in this instance’s data folder is damaged. Stackly never repairs or deletes data on its own.
Copy the data folder somewhere safe first.

Valkey’s own repair tool is valkey-check-aof, next to valkey-server in the runtime’s bin folder. Run it with --fix on this manifest file, then start the instance again. The repair drops every write after the damaged part.

title: Valkey found a damaged append only file
